remarks: Welcome to your beautiful, remodeled home at 300 Walnut St. Lockport. This beaty has 4 bedroom and 2 full baths, remodeled and decorated with many fixtures and shelving will be available for you. The 1st floor bathroom has new laundry units, and fresh new corner shower and fixtures. Spacious rooms throughout the lower level, updated kitchen with butcher block countertops, stainless steel sink & SS appliances, NICE eating area and luxury vinyl flooring. The new flooring will also be found into the formal dining area with plenty of room for your party or family needs. Upper floor has the 4 bedrooms & another remodeled full bath! If outside is your main choice, this one has NEW concrete edging out front around the NEW landscape, a covered front porch, a new concrete patio outback, fully fenced yard, with old trees removed and fresh sod in place. Also added is 2 new garage doors w/opener and so much more.... this home has character and updates! Walking distance to all amenities or near a bus route and downtown Lockport. Showing start immediately!
